input.selection: Resolve route record by operationId; do not trust historical array index
input.authority: Authenticated OWNER is resolved by the canonical server path, not request JSON or a boolean in a model proposal
input.conversion: Strict UTF8/JSON/duplicate-key/schema HTTP admission; exact caller-controlled body is canonicalized by the pinned canonical serializer without changing intent/credential text; server recomputes clientRequestDigest from operationId+body
input.kindAdmission: Owned CREATE/UPDATE/FOLLOW_UP/RETRY/REPAIR policies are resolved separately and rechecked under current locks; this proposal neither grants non-FOLLOW_UP eligibility nor borrows source-state guards
input.protectedStorage: Persist exact canonical typed body encrypted under the existing authenticated master-key mechanism. Directcredential must never appear as plaintext in root metadata, receipt, event, outbox or ordinary audit logs. This is protected generation input, not automatic secret_record/binding creation. Existing OWNER reveal and bounded Secret-use context remain unchanged.
input.cryptoPolicy: Production algorithm/key/nonce/retention binding must use the canonical profile. Nonempty algorithm/key fields or a fixture AEAD algorithm do not establish that profile. Missing exact profile is BLOCKED.
